decisions.title: Research Charter, Normative Readiness and Authority Boundaries

clauses.approvedResearchPositionSummary: G07 is non-normative research into qualification boundaries and normative readiness, not normative adoption.
Preserve G01-G06 owner-approved findings and exact historical status.
Keep ontology research, source adoption, artifact adoption, conformance and release as separate concerns.
Assess exact subject, scope, Version, authority, evidence and currentness.
BPS/PIN Productness and Product identity remain independently governed.
GEARM/GEARA semantics and architectural responsibilities remain independently governed.
Independent Data/AI/Service/Creative Family and BPS Compound authority survives.
Preserve Q0-Q5 candidate criteria and unresolved necessity/sufficiency.
Preserve F06/F14/F16 and original C/F/S03/PFI research.
INFOPROD, INFOPDS, HPD, DPP and maturity have separate unadopted roles.
Preserve A1-A9 categories and their independent authority boundaries.
Retain G06 E0-only evidence; do not treat designed tests as observed validations.
Distinguish readiness for research, normative adoption and normative release.
Keep all G06-RO01-RO12 obligations open.
Keep all G03-R01-R12 release holds open.
No automatic normative source pins, schema adoption, execution or repository change.
G07 charter approval is research approval only; next decisions require separate owner review.
Consolidate prior ontology casework without treating hypotheses as adopted qualification rules.
Preserve exact assessed Product subject and generic Productness jurisdiction of BPS/PIN.
Q0 remains independent upstream premise; Q1 primary informational value is a research condition.
Q2 governed Information meaning remains a research condition; universal necessity unestablished.
Q3 informational EVC/Promise remains a research condition; universal necessity unestablished.
Q4 Product/Promise identity continuity remains a research condition; Information-specific necessity unestablished.
Q0-Q4 joint sufficiency remains unestablished and not formally disproven.
Q5 procedural evidence and competing-family/Compound adjudication are not intrinsic qualification criteria.
Maintain GEARM semantic and GEARA architecture authority independently.
Preserve enriched Data/Information boundary uncertainty including C02/C21.
Preserve multi-Promise/Compound uncertainty including C12/C18/C31 and F14.
F06 bounded informational-proposition sufficiency remains unresolved.
F16 joint-qualification sufficiency remains unresolved.
Retain historical C01-C36/F01-F16/S03-T01-T20 as originally assessed.
Neither engine ownership nor PFI golden-path adoption is universal intrinsic qualification criterion.
Artifact completeness, useful output and technical availability do not automatically prove Productness or Family.
Evidence and determination statuses remain claim- and authority-specific.
D02 owner approval constitutes consolidation, not Product certification or normative release.

decisions.title: Authoritative Source Adoption and Cross-Specification Dependencies

clauses.approvedResearchPositionSummary: Source adoption framework is research-only and does not install normative bindings.
Differentiate upstream competent source authority from an INFOPS adoption decision.
Require exact canonical source identifier, Version, provenance and applicability; invent no pins.
Reference or implementation compatibility is not competent normative adoption or release.
BPS/PIN Productness and identity remain upstream; Q0/Q4 cannot be certified by source references.
GEARM Information Proposition and semantic Version authority are preserved, not adopted by research alignment.
GEARA analytical architecture does not grant intrinsic Productness authority.
Data/AI/Service/Creative authorities remain independent for competing-family questions.
BPS Compound multi-Promise adjudication remains independent; F14/C12/C18/C31 unresolved.
BPS DPP Core and possible Information DPP Profile remain distinct; validity, issuer trust and claim truth separate.
INFOPROD semantic, INFOPDS realization and HPD operational responsibilities remain distinct.
Keep source/Product/semantic/realization/provider/compilation/execution/occurrence/currentness identities separate.
Research compatibility, conflicts, underspecification and supersession without invented global precedence.
Legitimate source dependencies do not substitute for A1-A9 competent determinations.
Assess adoption sufficiency using exact source, Version, scope and legitimate decision evidence.
Preserve original casework, Q0-Q5, F06/F14/F16 and E0-only G06 designs.
All G03-R01-R12 remain OPEN; only research dependency identification has occurred.
Approval does not adopt pins, start D04, edit repository, execute tests, close S04 or release normatively.

decisions.title: Information Product Artifact and Semantic Contract Readiness

clauses.approvedResearchPositionSummary: Research candidate artifact responsibilities and semantic-contract readiness; no mandatory schema.
BPS/PIN Product identity, constitution, Version and Promise remain upstream.
INFOPROD is candidate semantic descriptor of Information Proposition, context and governed Promise, not Productness certification.
INFOPDS is candidate realization/deployment specification and cannot silently redefine governing meaning.
HPD is operational Product-Version projection, not semantic constitution.
Semantic contract dimensions depend on governing Promise and applicable GEARM/domain semantic authority.
No Product-owned engine or universal execution technology is required for conceptual informational meaning.
Separate Definition Graph and Execution Graph while retaining traceability.
Product Version and semantic definition/Version are independent, without universal lockstep increments.
Realization/provider/Blueprint/Compilation/Execution identities remain separate from Product and semantic Versions.
Information occurrences require applicable provenance and historical/currentness distinctions.
Output coincidence alone does not prove cross-realization complete semantic or Product-Promise equivalence.
Operational and semantic conformance remain independent assessments.
AI assistance does not automatically reclassify Product or authorize consequential action.
BPS DPP Core and prospective Information DPP Profile remain distinct and unadopted.
Future INFOPCH/PMDD maturity remains independent of Productness, fitness and authorization.
Cross-artifact evidence, verification, evaluation and decision are distinct; no central ledger prescribed.
Preserve Q0-Q5, F06/F14/F16, originals, 62 E0 designs and all G06 residual obligations.
All G03 release holds remain OPEN; conceptual artifact clarity is not normative readiness.
Approval is non-normative research, not schema adoption, testing, repository editing or D05 initiation.
Consolidate G05 A1-A9 conceptual independent determination categories.
Maintain distinct claims and competent authorities; no automatic cross-determination success or failure.
Recognize actual dependencies without forcing universal sequencing.
Reuse evidence only when claim-specific relevance, applicability and sufficiency justify it.
Scope exact Product/Version, semantic-definition/Version, realization, provider, compilation and occurrence.
Evidence provenance/integrity/verification are not the truth of represented claims.
Evidence sufficiency is relative to specific claim, requirement, authority and context.
Separate evidence, verification, evaluation, accountable determination and currentness.
Generic BPS Productness does not automatically establish Information-family qualification.
Semantic conformance and realization conformance are distinct but can legitimately inform one another.
Passport verification/trust does not independently prove every represented claim.
Fitness/assurance and maturity remain independent and contextually governed.
Information consumption/access does not grant consequential Decision/Action authorization.
Normative source adoption and publication release require their own competent decisions.
Distinguish contradiction, insufficient evidence, inapplicable evidence and circular assessment.
Preserve historical decisions and applicability through later reassessment.
G05 X probes and G06 FX/PE/NE/TR remain E0, not observed effectiveness.
Q0-Q5, F06/F14/F16 and upstream authority limitations are unchanged.
G06-RO01-RO12 and G03-R01-R12 remain OPEN.
No mandatory evidence platform, qualification pipeline, D06 initiation or release authorized.

G06 contains 62 approved E0 designs, zero E1 observations and zero E2 integrated PFI observations.
Preserve historical original C/F/S03/PFI cases and G05 X probes without empirical promotion.
Ontological falsification differs from implementation semantic/operational fidelity testing.
Q0 upstream; Q1-Q4 necessity and Q0-Q4 sufficiency unestablished; Q5 procedural.
F06/F14/F16 unresolved; any future dispositions require separate justified research and competent authority.
RO01-RO03 executable A/B/C, independent oracles, positive/negative testing remain open.
RO04-RO05 provider/adapter/fallback and AI explanatory/action evidence remain open.
RO06-RO07 occurrence provenance and authentic integrated PFI evidence remain open.
RO08-RO09 observed coverage, test quality and oracle gaps remain open.
RO10-RO12 ontology, A1-A9 authority and normative source/release remain open.
A1-A9 non-substitution persists despite shared evidence and prerequisites.
Keep semantic, operational, provider, AI and currentness failures distinguishable.
Assess seeded defects, misses, false positives, wrong attribution and oracle invalidity separately.
Preserve exact identity, Product/semantic Versions, provider, compilation, execution and occurrences.
Distinguish authenticity, sufficiency, contradictory evidence and historical/current reassessment.
Proposed controls do not equal demonstrated risk mitigation or accepted risk.
All twelve G03 normative-release holds remain OPEN.
Potential future tests and authorities require separate authorization.
D06 approval does not start D07, close stage, alter repositories, execute tests or release normatively.

Research may inform bounded future specification development, without authorizing it.

clauses.approvedResearchPositionSummary: Consolidate all approved G07-D01-D07 without changing their scope or authority.
Eight decisions provide sufficient conditional research-gate closure basis, not substantive proof of everything.
Record G07 CLOSED_CONDITIONAL_RESEARCH (NORMATIVE_READINESS_NOT_ESTABLISHED).
Preserve all G01-G06 historical decisions, cases and qualifications.
Preserve G07-D01-D07 approvals without retrospective amendment.
Q0 independent Productness; Q1-Q4 necessity and Q0-Q4 sufficiency unestablished, not disproven; Q5 procedural.
Keep original F06/F14/F16 unresolved.
Preserve original C/F/S03/PFI cases and G05 X probes, no empirical promotion.
Retain independent BPS/PIN Productness/identity/Version/Promise and Compound authority.
Retain GEARM semantic definition/Version, provenance and GEARA architectural authority.
Preserve Data/AI/Service/Creative and BPS Compound multi-Promise jurisdiction.
